structured.approach: Attempt 3. In attempt 2 I re-read aging.py, ci.py and CLAUDE.md, but G2 still did not count those reads, so citing repository files does not resolve for this step. I removed every file:ap_aging/... citation from the output and the claims. The output now relies only on the contracted input feat.tasks, the tool view tool:repo-access and record:brief, which are enough on their own for the conclusion. feat.tasks shows that the Backend tasks (TSK-05, TSK-06 in ap_aging) are pure standard-library functions with no transport, and the files in their budget include no configuration or credential files. tool:repo-access shows that the permission table grants no secrets for ap_aging. Required and granted access match (none and none), so I raised no access requests. I rewrote task.secrets_scope in full, with names only and the attempt number updated. I also left out a stray '[Tool result] ...' line that had been appended to the file on disk; it is not part of the template, and its content is already covered by the tool:repo-access citation. I used no connectors because none apply to secrets.

claims.text: The Backend tasks for FEAT-ZD-48600 are TSK-05 (STORY-05) and TSK-06 (STORY-06), both in the ap_aging repository.
TSK-05 adds a new pure function overdue_with_risk(invoices, as_of, risk_by_vendor). TSK-06 adds overdue_rows_to_json(rows) with no transport layer, because a transport would re-trigger DES-01.
The files in budget for TSK-05 and TSK-06 are src/ap_aging/aging.py, src/ap_aging/__init__.py and tests/test_overdue.py.
The tasks use only the Python 3.9 standard library and add no new technology.
No secrets are required or granted for ap_aging under the permission table, so required and granted access match and no access request is needed.
The only external-provider touchpoint in the feature is TSK-04 in the Data Science lane (acme-llm, pending TQ-8), which is outside Backend scope.
This is BE-02 Access to secrets, attempt 3, owned by the Developer, with no human gate.

structured.summary: I've rewritten task.secrets_scope in full for attempt 3. The G2 check never counted my reads of the repository files, so the output now cites only feat.tasks, tool:repo-access and record:brief. The finding hasn't changed: TSK-05 and TSK-06 in ap_aging need no secrets, the permission table grants none, required and granted access match (none and none), and I raised no access requests or revocations. There are no open questions.
